Local News: New Cycle Lane Opens

A new protected cycle lane opened on Monday along Station Road, linking the town centre to the railway station.

The 2-kilometre lane cost 1.4 million pounds and took eight months to build. It is separated from traffic by a raised kerb.

The council expects around 1,500 cycle journeys a day. Some local shop owners have raised concerns about the loss of parking spaces.

A second lane, to the hospital, is planned for next year.
